name: minecraft-companion
description: Overwolf companion with interactive game maps, a connected wiki, in-game overlays and world tools.

scripts.test:map: node --experimental-strip-types scripts/test-map-projection.mjs && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/test-map-clustering.mjs && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/test-map-search.mjs && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/test-saved-map-migrations.mjs && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/test-world-route.mjs
